title: RACKD listing
description: One secondhand item, in the same shape no matter which site it came from. Every source (Depop, Etsy, eBay...) is converted into this shape before it is saved.

id.description: RACKD's own id: source + ':' + sourceId, e.g. depop:vintage-levis-501-abc123

source.description: Which site the item is listed on

sourceId.description: The site's own id or slug for the item

url.description: The listing page, where the buyer actually buys

affiliateUrl.description: Floor 7: tracked link that earns RACKD a commission. Null until an affiliate program is live for this source

originalPrice.description: Price before a markdown, if the site shows one

size.description: As the seller wrote it: M, 8, 32x30, OS (one size)

condition.description: e.g. new with tags, used - like new

style.description: Style tag from the site if it has one (streetwear, y2k...)

photoUrl.description: Main photo, shown on the swipe card and read by FashionCLIP

sellerRating.description: Seller's average review score, used to show only well-rated sellers

status.description: Only active items are shown in the app

missedChecks.description: How many re-checks in a row could not find the item. At 2, it is marked removed

scrapedFor.description: The user whose style search found this item. Other users only see it if it is a strong match for them

foundFor.description: Every user whose own refresh found this item. It counts as theirs, not as a shared listing

lastCheckedAt.description: Last time RACKD confirmed it is still for sale. Checked again just before showing if older than the stale limit
